name: ACA 909 女客心脏病 听不到通播

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 909, your destination is Beijing, and you are leaving 1200 meters and say good-bye to Wuhan Tower, contact Wuhan Approach and request to climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 909，目的地 Beijing，正在离开 1200 米，并向武汉塔台告别，联系武汉进近并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA 909, leaving 1200 meters, request further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA 909，离开 1200 米，请求继续爬升。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 909, Wuhan Approach, good morning, radar contact, follow ZF-1D departure, climb to 1800 meters on QNH 1013.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 909，武汉进近，早上好，雷达识别，执行 ZF-1D 离场，按 QNH 1013 爬升到 1800 米。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-1D departure, climb to 1800 meters on QNH 1013, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF-1D 离场，按 QNH 1013 爬升到 1800 米，ACA 909。

cards.audioText: B: You just reached 1800 meters and you got some moderate chop at the level, inform the controller about that and request 4500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你刚到达 1800 米，在该高度遇到中度颠簸，通知管制员并请求 4500 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA 909, maintaining 1800 meters, we have encountered moderate turbulence, request 4500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA 909，保持 1800 米，我们遇到中度颠簸，请求 4500 米。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 909, Approach, unable to approve 4500 meters due traffic, 3900 meters available.
B: Tell the controller that you want to climb to 3900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 909，进近，由于交通原因不能批准 4500 米，3900 米可用。
B: 告诉管制员你想爬升到 3900 米。
cards.referenceText: We accept 3900 meters, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们接受 3900 米，ACA 909。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller that the weather radar shows a cumulonimbus on route ahead about 30 Kilometers, and your level is 3900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员气象雷达显示航路前方约 30 公里有积雨云，你的高度是 3900 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA 909, maintaining 3900 meters, the weather radar shows a CB ahead of us, about 30 km.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA 909，保持 3900 米，气象雷达显示我们前方有 CB，约 30 公里。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, ACA 909, report your intentions.
B: Tell the controller that you want radar guidance to go round the CB.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，ACA 909，报告你的意图。
B: 告诉管制员你需要雷达引导绕飞 CB。
cards.referenceText: Request radar vector to circumnavigate the CB, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导绕飞 CB，ACA 909。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 909, turn left heading 300.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 909，左转航向 300。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 300, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 300，ACA 909。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 909, now you are cleared of the CB, climb to 4500 meters, turn right heading 030 to rejoin the ZF-1D departure.
B: Acknowledge the controller's instruction and tell him you want to fly to ZF directly from present position.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 909，现在你已脱离 CB，爬升到 4500 米，右转航向 030 重新加入 ZF-1D 离场。
B: 确认管制员指令，并告诉他你想从当前位置直飞 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Roger, climb to 4500 meters, request direct to ZF, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，爬升到 4500 米，请求直飞 ZF，ACA 909。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 909, cleared direct to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 909，可以直飞 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Cleared direct to ZF, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以直飞 ZF，ACA 909。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 909, maintain 4500 meters, contact Wuhan Control on 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 909，保持 4500 米，联系武汉管制118.1。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 4500 meters, 118.1, ACA 909.

cards.audioText: B: You are just over ZF, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你刚过 ZF，与 武汉管制 建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 909, maintain 4500 meters, over ZF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 909，保持 4500 米，过 ZF。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 909, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to 8900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 909，武汉管制，雷达识别，爬升到 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 8900 meters, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 8900 米，ACA 909。

cards.audioText: B: A flight attendant told you that there is a male passenger suffering a heart attack, inform the controller about that and tell him you want to go back to Wuhan. This is an Urgent call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 一名乘务员告诉你有一名男性旅客心脏病发作，通知管制员，并告诉他你想返回 Wuhan。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, ACA 909, We have a male passenger suffering heart attack, request direct back to Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，ACA 909，我们有一名男性旅客心脏病发作，请求直飞返回 Wuhan。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 909, Wuhan Control, roger PAN PAN, turn right direct to ZF, and descend to 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 909，武汉管制，收到 PANPAN，右转直飞 ZF，下降到 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to ZF, descend to 4200 meters, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 ZF，下降到 4200 米，ACA 909。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 909, do you need any medical assistance?
B: Tell the controller that you need a physician and an ambulance upon landing or after landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 909，你们需要医疗援助吗？
B: 告诉管制员你们着陆时或着陆后需要医生和救护车。
cards.referenceText: We need a physician and an ambulance upon arrival, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们到达时需要医生和救护车，ACA 909。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, an ambulance and a physician will be ready.
C: ACA 909, Wuhan Control, maintain 4200 meters, contact Approach on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，救护车和医生会准备好。
C: ACA 909，武汉管制，保持 4200 米，联系 进近 118.9。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 4200 meters, 118.9, ACA 909.

cards.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Approach that you have a passenger suffering heart attack and request landing priority.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知 武汉进近 你有一名旅客心脏病发作，并请求着陆优先。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA 909, we have a passenger suffering heart attack, request priority for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA 909，我们有一名旅客心脏病发作，请求着陆优先。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 909, Wuhan Approach, roger, radar contact, follow ZF-1A arrival and descend to 1800 meters on QNH 1013, information D is valid.
B: Read back the controller's instruction and ask the detail of Information D, because you could not receive the Information on the radio.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 909，武汉进近，收到，雷达识别，执行 ZF-1A 进场，按 QNH 1013 下降到 1800 米，信息 D 有效。
B: 复诵管制员指令，并询问信息 D 的详情，因为你无法通过无线电接收该信息。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-1A arrival, descend to 1800 meters on QNH 1013, can you repeat the ATIS? We are unable to pick it up on the radio.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF-1A 进场，按 QNH 1013 下降到 1800 米，请重复 ATIS？无线电无法收到。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 909, Approach, surface wind 350 degrees at 3 meters per second, visibility 8 Kilometers, ILS approach runway in use 36R, QNH 1013 hectopascal.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 909，进近，地面风 350 度 3 米/秒，能见度 8 公里，使用跑道 36R ILS 进近，QNH 1013 百帕。
cards.referenceText: ILS approach Runway 36R, QNH 1013 hpa, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R ILS 进近，QNH 1013 hpa，ACA 909。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you want to land at the Runway 18L visually to save time.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你想目视降落跑道 18L 以节省时间。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA 909, request to make a visual approach for Runway 18L to save time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA 909，请求目视进近跑道 18L 以节省时间。
